description.fallback: On their way to the Fire Temple, Team Yamato decide to stop for the night and prepare a campfire. After Yamato scares Naruto, Sakura decides to ask about their mission and why people would rob graves. Yamato reminds her of her fight with Sasori, in which the puppet master used the body of the Third Kazekage to create a puppet.

outro.fallback: Yamato reminds her of her fight with Sasori, in which the puppet master used the body of the Third Kazekage to create a puppet.
